name: utf16_urls
description: String candidates for URLs, file: and Visited: entries and 192.168.x.x addresses in a file; not a browser parser. ascii: http:// or https:// and at least six URL characters, to the first byte that is not one, with no length cut off. utf16le: a run of at least eight printable-ASCII characters (each in two bytes) that contains http, file:, visited: or 192.168; a character outside printable ASCII ends the run, so a URL with one is found only up to it. Every occurrence is kept with its byte offset and encoding (the same text twice is two candidates); a groups view lists each distinct text once with its count and first offset (bounded by max_distinct, and says when it stopped growing). The file is read in windows with a carry, never whole, so a match that straddles a window is found once; a run longer than the carry is returned in adjacent pieces (continued: true on all but the last) so no character is lost. A string does not say it was visited, typed, downloaded or opened, or by whom. SENSITIVE: a URL can carry a session token or a password in its query string or user-info; run it as a job with secret_output: true when the file may.

contains.description: Optional substring filter (case-insensitive) on the candidate text; the candidates it leaves out are counted under filtered_out_by_contains

limit.description: Candidates and groups shown inline, each (default 200, an inline page size); every one is kept, and when there are more the whole list is written as JSON Lines and named in all_results

chunk.description: Bytes read per window (default 8 MiB, from 131072 to 268435456)

max_distinct.description: Distinct texts the groups view tracks (default 100000); past it the view stops growing and groups_complete is false, while every occurrence is still a candidate
